The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 52c828f91521d93c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: The morphism Y → S × Λ is smooth of relative dimension 2R + 2b, and X → A1 is smooth of relative dimension 2R. Their total spaces are semiprojective for scaling the operators, which scales λ and every ui with weight one. The same holds for the inverse image in Y of every linear subspace of Λ through zero. In Figure 1, π is a smooth proper flag projection of relative dimension b, and ι is a regular embedding of codimension b with normal bundle T∗ π .
